text_block_list.text:
To thank her for helping soothe my fatigue 
lately, we visited a nature park.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Waaah~! The scent of the greenery... Fufu, 
it's so refreshing and nice!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I'm very happy about the reward! 
I'm happy, but...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure it's not boring for you...? 
Since we're only doing things I like...

Every single method of "healing" she had 
introduced during our outings so far had 
proven remarkably effective.

If it brings her peace and healing, then 
I'm sure it will be a source of comfort 
for me as well.

So I want you to relax and heal your heart 
to your heart's content, without any 
pressure. That is what I told—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ah, thank you so much...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Well then, taking you up on that offer, 
I'm gonna be pampered and healed to my 
heart's content today!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ah, look over there! There are pretty 
fishies!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
The babbling river amid all the 
greenery... it's wonderful! Whoa, that 
river from before looks so tiny now—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ah, ah, ah... w-wait up. I had no idea 
this suspension bridge was so high...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
U-Um... just while we're crossing, would 
it be okay... if you held my hand?
(Piiiiiiiii)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, it's a grass whistle. It's been a 
while since I played one, so it sounded a 
bit funny, didn't it?
choice_data_list: Tell me how to do it.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Of course! First, let's find a long, 
slender leaf. Then, place it against your 
lipsâ

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you for the plum kelp tea. There's 
really nothing like this when you're 
tired."
choice_data_list: It really works like a charm~
It really works like a charm~

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Besides, relaxing times like this 
are—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, no. It's about time to head back, 
shall we go?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much for today! I had so 
much fun!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...I'm so glad. And... I feel so happy.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um, do you remember, Trainer? When I told 
you that I love spending time just 
relaxing?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
It feels so comforting, like there's 
nothing in the world to worry about...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: A soft, fluffy... warm sensation.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Now that the neighborhood elders aren't 
around anymore... I never imagined I'd get 
to share that kind of time with someone 
again.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: That's why—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Trainer, thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for spending that time with me. 
It made me so, so happy the whole time!
choice_data_list:
I can accompany you for something like 
this anytime.
Want to just take it easy next time?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yes. I look forward to working with you!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Still, if I can relax this much, I feel 
like I can try even harder in my races!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's right. If we get good results 
in the race, why don't we come here again?
choice_data_list: I think that's a good idea.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Then I'll have to work even harder!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I want to get good results in my races so 
we can relax together again!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Wooww... Amazing. You really are an adult, 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Yes! She has so much composure, she feels 
very reliable...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"I need to become a mature Umamusume so I 
can stand proudly beside you, Trainer..."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
With you as my role model, Trainer, I'll 
do my best!

For her sake as well, I resolved to 
conduct myself as a dependable adult.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Sounds great! In that case, we'll need tea 
snacks!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I have some mizu-yokan that goes perfectly 
with tea. Leave the preparations to me!

Later on, I had a relaxing teatime with an 
enthusiastic Nishino Flower, and just as 
she had said, it was an addictive kind of 
comforting...
